{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Gold Devil Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 5 [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] employed by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. After discovering Tarrak's [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] where she was building [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. Then, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] launched an [[Capture of Ali Tarrak|assault]] to put an end to her attempt to proliferate the TIE Defenders. '''Gold Devil Squadron''' was dispatched to attack the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Grey Wolf]]''. But were intercepted and destroyed in the battle.
